title: When you start walking in your God-given purpose, don’t be surprised when resistance shows up.
paragraphs:
When you start walking in your God-given purpose, don’t be surprised when resistance shows up.
Storms rise not because you’re weak — but because your light is waking the darkness.

Keep standing. Keep believing. The fire in you is proof that heaven chose you for something greater.
💫 Your faith is what the enemy fears most.

📖 Isaiah 54:17
“No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against you in judgment you shall condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord.”
